notes.title: ver1.01 bug fix update
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing.
We have fixed a bug that severely impeded progression.
Fixed a bug that caused the player's position and camera to spawn in the correct place.
Fixed a bug that prevented data from being transferred correctly when transferring data.

We will soon adjust the game balance and make various adjustments to make it easier to play.
Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Official release on March 15, 5:00 p.m!
notes.notes:
We will officially release the game on March 15 at 5:00 pm!

Basic play is free, so please play!
You can also battle with your friends, so we hope you will invite your friends to join us.
Android and iOS versions will be released at the same time.
You can play with people on all platforms!

The Aegis Rifle is a non-habitual long-range weapon, while the Ice Wall makes a shield that protects against enemy long-range attacks.
Both are easy-to-use equipment, so be sure to get them!
